fields.title: The US launches new large-scale strikes on Iran by May 18, 2027
fields.text: By May 18, 2027 the United States carries out a new round of military strikes on Iranian territory, resuming the war that Trump has so far held off restarting. Brent has fallen by more than a fifth in November as Middle East supply recovered.
fields.resolution_source: US government confirmation; major news reporting
